info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Loan Application By Offer Id-spec
info.description: This API provides the ability to access specific loan application details based on a given offer ID. It enables financial institutions and service providers to efficiently retrieve information on loan applications that are linked to user offers. Key consumers of this API include loan officers, customer service representatives, and integration developers looking to streamline loan processing workflows. The operation supports improved decision-making by providing timely access to application data.

get.summary: Retrieve Loan Offers for a Specific Application
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch all available loan offers related to a specific loan application identified by its unique ID. It responds with the details of the offers that may be relevant for the applicant to consider.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve loan offer details for a specific loan application identified by its unique identifier. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included to obtain the desired offer information.
